tagline.en_US: Official Rclone image adapted as a native Proxmox OCI LXC with persistent configuration, authenticated WebUI and optional FUSE publication for other LXCs.

description.en_US: Rclone is a program designed to synchronize files and directories to and from numerous cloud storage providers and local filesystems. It supports one-way synchronization, bidirectional syncing, and direct file copying while verifying data integrity using checksums. Additionally, it offers virtual storage features such as on-the-fly encryption, compression, file chunking, and mounting remotes.
